# FairPrice immutable research captures

Research phase captured the product promotions root, one failed guessed root, the visibly linked weekly root, a refused legal page, and two exact catalogue viewer shells. Each research directory contains original response bytes, an append-only request/capture ledger and replay manifest. The root manifest composes them without copying or altering bodies.

Production shadow replay acquires only /weekly-promotions. Its 24 inline publication IDs/URLs/title/periods must match their exact DOM cards. Product price/JSON-LD/validTill never supplies candidate facts. Catalogue completeness is not campaign/product or physical participation completeness. No catalogue backend, product API or OCR is used.

See docs/changes/direct-source-batch-1/research.md for ownership and blockers. Do not refresh these files in place.
